# Saffron Grill — Full Knowledge Base & AI Agent Context

## 1. Restaurant Profile & Identity
- **Legal Business Name**: Saffron Grill
- **Brand Identity**: Authentic Indian Cuisine, Lunch Buffet & Luxury Event Catering
- **Physical Location**: 3191 Crow Canyon Place, Suite D, San Ramon, CA 94583, United States
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 37.7663° N, Longitude 121.9745° W
- **Telephone**: (925) 846-3077 | Alternative: (925) 369-4696
- **Email**: gosaffrongrill@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://saffrongrillsanramon.com

## 2. Operating Schedule & Buffet Pricing
### Lunch Buffet Service
- **Monday through Friday**: 11:30 AM to 3:00 PM ($19.99 per adult, children special pricing)
- **Saturday and Sunday**: 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM ($21.99 per adult)
- **Buffet Features**:
  - Over 20 hot items refreshed continuously
  - Fresh hot garlic or butter naan brought straight to your table
  - Multiple vegetarian and halal non-vegetarian selections
  - Live salad bar, raita, fresh mint and tamarind chutneys
  - Traditional Indian desserts: Warm Gulab Jamun, Royal Rasmalai, Mango Kheer

### Dinner Service
- **Daily (7 Days / Week)**: 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM
- **Dinner Style**: Full fine-dining à la carte experience with customized spice levels (Mild, Medium, Hot, Extra Hot).

## 3. Dietary Accommodations
- **Halal**: All non-vegetarian chicken, lamb, and goat meats are Halal certified.
- **Vegetarian / Vegan**: Extensive dedicated vegetarian curries, appetizers, and vegan options clearly indicated.
- **Gluten-Free**: Most curries, tandoori meats, and basmati rice dishes are naturally gluten-free (except tandoori breads).
- **Nut Allergies**: Coconut, cashew, and almond paste are used in select korma gravies; staff accommodates nut allergies upon notice.

## 4. Catering & Private Event Services
- **Service Capacities**: Catering for 25 to 1,000+ guests.
- **Packages**:
  - **Silver Feast ($22/person)**: 2 Appetizers, 2 Curries, Rice, Naan, Salad, Raita, Dessert.
  - **Royal Gold Banquet ($28/person)**: 3 Appetizers (including Tandoori Grill), 3 Curries, Dum Biryani, Assorted Naans, Salad, Raita, 2 Desserts.
  - **Imperial Maharaja ($36/person)**: 4 Gourmet Appetizers, 4 Entrees, Special Biryani, Gourmet Breads, Full Chutney Bar, 3 Desserts, Optional Live Tandoor on-site chef.
- **Equipment & Staffing**: Chafing dishes, sternos, serving ware, buffet setup, and professional on-site servers available.
- **Service Locations**: Venues, corporate campuses, community centers, and private estates across Contra Costa and Alameda counties.

## 5. Location & Directions
- Situated in Crow Canyon Plaza off Crow Canyon Place in San Ramon.
- Accessible directly from Interstate 680 (Crow Canyon Rd exit).
- Ample complimentary on-site plaza parking available.
